notes.title: The English version is published now!
notes.notes:
Hey, our cool developers!

iFAction has offered the English version on March 22, and today we have updated two quick-start tutorials with English subtitles for you to help you understand iFAction. Anyway, We hope everyone can use iFAction to make your own game!

After the last update, we have made the following improvements :
1. We updated two tutorials with English subtitles on YouTube
ACT Quick Start Tutorial >> [url=https://youtu.be/3OYxH2gw0Bo]click me to see[/url]  
ARPG Quick Start Tutoriall >>[url=https://youtu.be/suYWUvpZJu8] click me to see[/url]  
2. We published some resources with English version in the asset store, and we will continue to update more in the future.
3. We fixed some Bugs
4. We made some adjustments to the software

Finally, if you have any problems, please feel free to contact us at xb@cedong.com.cn. 
We believe we can solve it together.

notes.title: The English version of iFAction is published now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The English version of iFAction is published now!
Thank you for your support and expectations for such a loooooong time!

Besides, we feel so sorry for the late of English language support on tutorial and asset store due to the epidemic. This part will be offered to you as soon as possible.
We would like to apologize again for the inconvenience!

Our plans for the coming weeks are:
·English version of ACT and ARPG tutorial
·English version for products in the asset store
·Improve manuals of some MOD

Finally, if you have any problems, please feel free to contact us at xb@cedong.com.cn. 
We believe we can solve it together.

>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
